model: Dynasonics TFX-5000 ultrasonic flow / energy meter (BACnet/IP card)
equipment_type: Ultrasonic flow and BTU meter (BACnet IP card)
applies_to: Badger Meter Dynasonics TFX-5000 flow and energy (BTU) meters fitted with the optional Ethernet card set to BACnet/IP.
summary: With the optional Ethernet card set to BACnet/IP, the TFX-5000 serves a read-only set of Analog Values: flow rate and velocity (home-screen, US and metric units), totals and overflow counters in home-screen units, gallons and liters, cutoff settings and signal strength, plus Multi-state Values that report the selected units. Energy meters add energy rate, two temperatures, delta T and energy totals in home-screen units, kBTU and kWh. The instance numbers differ from the RS-485 BACnet MS/TP list.
notes: This is the energy-meter table; flow-only meters lack AV 604-607, AV 802, AV 1002, AV 1309, the energy totals and counters (AV 1108-1115, 1158-1165, 1208-1215) and MV 1306, 1308, 1309.
Every object in this list is read-only; the BACnet/IP card has no reset or reboot objects.
The flow-meter table names AV 1500 'Signal Strength'; the energy-meter table calls it 'Signal Quality'.
Several overflow counters share a name; the instance tells them apart.
If the BACnet/IP menu is missing, set Main Menu > System Setup > Options > Card Type to Autodetect or BACnet/IP.

source.title: TFX-5000 Meter BACnet/IP Ethernet Protocol User Manual

integration.summary: Fit the Ethernet card, set Card Type to Autodetect or BACnet/IP, then read flow rate, the net total and (on BTU meters) energy rate, temperatures and the net energy total. All objects are read-only.
setup: The BACnet/IP card is an option with an RJ-45 port; set Main Menu > System Setup > Options > Card Type to Autodetect or BACnet/IP.
Network and BACnet settings are made in the meter's BACnet/IP menu.
gotchas: Totals are 32-bit AVs only on this card; watch the overflow counters on large totals.
Flow-only meters do not have the energy and temperature objects.
Instance numbers differ from the RS-485 BACnet MS/TP list; don't reuse an MS/TP mapping.
